company.name: Gas Pos
company.shortDescription: Gas Pos is the fastest-growing point of sale system for gas stations & truck stops. First truck stop POS alternative in 20 years.
company.description:
Gas Pos is the the most modern fuel point of sale system for gas stations, truck stops, convenience stores & marinas across the USA. Additionally, we're pleased to announce that Gas Pos is the first truck stop point of sale alternative with fleet card acceptance in 20 years.

Gas Pos was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Birmingham, AL.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based point of sale system designed for gas stations and truck stops to manage fuel sales and transactions.
productsAndServices.name: Fuel Point of Sale System (Fuel POS)

productsAndServices.description: Hardware equipment including EMV-compliant fuel dispensers and pumps for gas stations and truck stops to securely dispense fuel.
productsAndServices.name: EMV Fuel Dispensers and Pumps

productsAndServices.description: Cloud-based back office software for managing gas station and truck stop operations, including inventory and pricing.
productsAndServices.name: Advanced Back Office Software

productsAndServices.description: A subscription-based program providing hardware, software, installation, and maintenance services for gas station POS and fuel dispensing equipment.
productsAndServices.name: Equipment as a Service Program

productsAndServices.description: Payment processing services integrated with the Gas Pos system, supporting credit, debit, fleet cards, and loyalty programs.
productsAndServices.name: Gas Pos Merchant Services (Payment Processing)

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $150,000, or 3.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,167,019 to $15,968,284, a 7.37x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 53 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 37 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Gilbarco Veeder Root, Verifone, National Retail Solutions.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
